tools.name: datacastle_audit_customs_document
tools.description: Performs deep audit and entity extraction on EU freight and customs documents (CMR Consignment Notes, Tullverket SAD Customs Declarations, Commercial Invoices). Extracts TARIC/HS codes, gross/net weights, Incoterms, currency, and cross-checks for discrepancy risks.

tools.name: datacastle_reconcile_freight_discrepancy
tools.description: Performs deterministic reconciliation between commercial invoice items and packing list / waybill shipping manifests. Compares line-item quantities, gross/net weights, declared customs values, and flags variances exceeding legal tolerances.

tools.name: datacastle_verify_taric_code
tools.description: Validates an EU 8-to-10 digit TARIC / HS Customs Classification Code. Verifies chapter hierarchy, numerical syntax, checks against EU customs nomenclature, and audits alignment with provided goods description.

tools.name: datacastle_check_ai_act_compliance
tools.description: Evaluates enterprise AI architectures and logistics software against the EU AI Act (Regulation EU 2024/1689). Classifies risk tier (Prohibited, High-Risk, Transparency, Minimal), assesses Article 10 data governance compliance, and generates required technical documentation mandates.
